name: 23964-decodeheavy-30ba3b-dp4ep
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, all four GPUs of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=4, expert parallelism ON: ep_size = dp x tp = 4, so the 128 experts are split 32 per rank.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2048 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, static seed 23964.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 128 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both; EOS is ignored and max_tokens is pinned to 1024.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating 1000-word replies from brief prompts for 256 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B

tensor-parallel-size: 1
data-parallel-size: 4
enable-expert-parallel: true

# Per engine, so each of the four DP ranks admits 256.
max-num-seqs: 256

max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.8
